nitnuckle-and-lunks-close-combat-weapons.name: Nitnuckle and Lunk's Close Combat Weapons

accidental-figurehead.name: Accidental Figurehead
accidental-figurehead.text: Friendly GOFF GRETCHIN units can use this model's Leadership instead of their own whilst they are within 12" of this model.

ghazghkulls-waaagh-banner.name: Ghazghkull's Waaagh! Banner
ghazghkulls-waaagh-banner.text: Friendly GOFF ORK units have the Ignore Damage (6+) ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit and this unit is within 3" of a friendly GHAZGHKULL THRAKA unit.

keep-up.name: Keep Up!
keep-up.text: If this unit starts a Move action within 3" of a friendly GHAZGHKULL THRAKA unit, add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic whilst making that Move action.

waaagh-goff.name: Waaagh! (Goff)
waaagh-goff.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly GOFF units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

great-waaagh.name: Great Waaagh!
great-waaagh.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly ORKS LIGHT units whilst they are making Fight actions whilst within 6" of this unit.

prophet-of-gork-and-mork.name: Prophet of Gork and Mork
prophet-of-gork-and-mork.text: When placing blast markers next to this unit, if it has a small blast marker next to it, place one small blast marker instead of replacing the existing one with a large blast marker. When placing blast markers next to this unit, if it has two small blast markers next to it, replace them both with one large blast marker.

waaagh.name: Waaagh!
waaagh.text: Each time you roll an unmodified hit roll of 6+ for an attack made by an ORKS unit in this Detachment, you can immediately make one additional attack at the same target using the same weapon (this additional attack cannot generate more).

waaagh-evil-sunz.name: Waaagh! (Evil Sunz)
waaagh-evil-sunz.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly EVIL SUNZ units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

big-mekaniak-goff.name: Big Mekaniak! (Goff)
big-mekaniak-goff.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly GOFF VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

kustom-force-field-goff.name: Kustom Force Field (Goff)
kustom-force-field-goff.text: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by ranged weapons that target GOFF units whilst they are wholly within 9" of any friendly GOFF units with a Kustom Force Field.

nitnuckle-and-lunk.name: Nitnuckle and Lunk
nitnuckle-and-lunk.text: If this unit contains 3 models, then when this unit uses the Big Mekaniak ability, you can re-roll the result.

mega-charger.name: Mega-Charger
mega-charger.text: If this unit has a Mega-charger, then once per battle it can move up to an additional 8" when it makes a Move action.

kustom-force-field.name: Kustom Force Field
kustom-force-field.text: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by ranged weapons that target <CLAN> units whilst they are wholly within 9" of any friendly <CLAN> units with a Kustom Force Field.

bigbomm.name: Bigbomm
bigbomm.text: When this unit finishes making a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll four D6, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a CHARACTER and adding 1 to each result if that unit is garrisoning a Defensible Terrain feature; for each result of 4+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

repair-krew.name: Repair Krew
repair-krew.text: Once per Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair itself. If it does, roll one D6; on a 3+, remove one damage marker from this unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

waaagh-2.name: Waaagh!
waaagh-2.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly <CLAN> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

waaagh-energy.name: Waaagh! Energy
waaagh-energy.text: At the start of the Action phase, if this unit is within 6" of three or more friendly <CLAN> units that each contain at least 10 models, you can turn over the top 3 cards of your Command Asset deck. If you reveal any Command Asset cards that are psychic powers, you can select one of those psychic powers and put in into your hand. Then put the remaining cards back in your Command Asset deck and shuffle the deck.

red-skull-kommandos.name: Red Skull Kommandos
red-skull-kommandos.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly BLOOD AXE KOMMANDOS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

drill-boss.name: Drill Boss
drill-boss.text: Morale tests taken for friendly GOFF STORMBOYZ units are automatically passed whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

flashiest-gitz.name: Flashiest Gitz
flashiest-gitz.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly FLASH GITZ units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

speedwaaagh.name: Speedwaaagh!
speedwaaagh.text: If a <CLAN> SPEED FREEKS unit starts a Move action within 6" of any friendly units with this ability, add 3" to that unit’s Move characteristic whilst making that Move action.

sawbonez-no-clan.name: Sawbonez (No Clan)
sawbonez-no-clan.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to heal one friendly ORKS LIGHT unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+, remove one damage marker from that LIGHT unit. Only one attempt to heal each unit can be made each turn.

sawbonez.name: Sawbonez
sawbonez.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to heal one friendly <CLAN> LIGHT unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+, remove one damage marker from that LIGHT unit. Only one attempt to heal each unit can be made each turn.

big-mekaniak.name: Big Mekaniak!
big-mekaniak.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly <CLAN> VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

bomb-squigs.name: Bomb Squigs
bomb-squigs.text: Once per battle, after this unit makes a Shoot action, select one enemy VEHICLE unit (other than an AIRCRAFT) within 18" of this unit and roll one D6. On a 4+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

tank-hunters.name: Tank Hunters
tank-hunters.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by this unit that target VEHICLE units.

shokk-tunnel.name: Shokk Tunnel
shokk-tunnel.text: When this unit makes a Move action, roll one D6 before moving it. On a 5+ instead of making a Move action, this unit can create a shokk tunnel. If it has any blast markers next to it, you must first resolve damage for it as if it were the Damage phase. If it is not destroyed, remove this unit from the battlefield, set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from any enemy units and then roll one D12; on a 1, place one blast marker next to this unit.

billowing-fumes.name: Billowing Fumes
billowing-fumes.text: This unit is always an obscured target.

squig-mine.name: Squig Mine
squig-mine.text: Once per battle, after an enemy unit has made a Move action that ends within 6" of this unit, you can roll a D6; on a 3+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

periscope.name: Periscope
periscope.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, if it has remained stationary or moved a distance less than half its Move characteristic this turn, double the Attacks characteristic of its Kannon, Killkannon and Zzap Gun for that action.

dread-mob.name: Dread Mob
dread-mob.text: Each Heavy Support slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single Heavy Support slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

all-da-dakka.name: All da Dakka
all-da-dakka.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit with ranged weapons.

burna-bombs.name: Burna Bombs
burna-bombs.text: After this unit makes a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll three D6, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a CHARACTER and adding 1 to each result if that unit is garrisoning a Defensible Terrain feature; for each result of 4+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

boom-bomb.name: Boom Bomb
boom-bomb.text: After this unit makes a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll two D6, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a CHARACTER and adding 1 to each result if that unit is HEAVY or SUPER-HEAVY; for each result of 3+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

stompa-rigger-krew.name: Stompa Rigger Krew
stompa-rigger-krew.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair itself. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+, remove one damage marker from this unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

kustom-job.name: Kustom Job
kustom-job.text: At the start of the Orders phase, the player who set up this terrain feature can select one ORKS HEAVY VEHICLE unit from their army that is within 3" of this terrain feature. Remove one damage marker from that unit and, until the end of the turn, add 3" to that unit’s Move characteristic and add 1 to hit rolls made by that unit with ranged weapons.

grabbin-klaw.name: Grabbin' Klaw
grabbin-klaw.text: At the end of the Action phase, if there are any units that are not ORKS units within 3" of this terrain feature, roll one D12; on an 8+ place one blast marker next to the closest unit to this terrain feature that is not an ORKS unit (if two or more such units are equally close, select one and place one blast marker next to that unit).

grot-guided-bomm-2.name: Grot-guided Bomm
grot-guided-bomm-2.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by this unit with a Grot-guided Bomm.

small-bomms.name: Small Bomms
small-bomms.text: If this unit has Small Bomms, then when this unit finishes making a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll two D6, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a CHARACTER and adding 1 to each result if that unit is HEAVY or SUPER-HEAVY; for each result of 5+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

krusha-kannon-2.name: Krusha Kannon
krusha-kannon-2.text: Attacks made with a Krusha Kannon that target a unit within 18 automatically score a hit (no hit roll is made) if the target unit is within 18".

waaagh-banner-2.name: Waaagh! Banner
waaagh-banner-2.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by <CLAN> units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly <CLAN> units with this ability.

last-laff.name: Last Laff
last-laff.text: When this unit is destroyed, if it explodes, place three blast markers next to every unit (excluding SUPER-HEAVY units) that is within 12" of this unit, instead of one within 6".

big-kustom-force-field.name: Big Kustom Force Field
big-kustom-force-field.text: Roll D12s while making saving throws for all <CLAN> units whilst they are wholly within 9" of any friendly <CLAN> units with a Big Kustom Force Field, irrespective of the size of the blast markers next to it

kan-oppna.name: Kan Oppna
kan-oppna.text: If this unit has a Kan Oppna, then

beast-snagga.name: Beast Snagga
beast-snagga.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit that target HEAVY units.

snagged.name: Snagged
snagged.text: Each time this model makes an attack with its stikka kannon against an enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER model (excluding TITANIC or AIRCRAFT models) and successfully wounds the target, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy model cannot finish any type of move more than 12" from this model until the start of the next turn. If this model moves for any reason, or is destroyed, this effect ends.

lifta-droppa-2.name: Lifta Droppa
lifta-droppa-2.text: If an attack made with a Lifta-droppa successfully wounds a HEAVY unit, roll one D12; on a 5+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

stampede.name: Stampede!
stampede.text: After this unit ends a Move action, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit, adding 2 to the result if that enemy unit is LIGHT; on a 4+ place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

ram.name: Ram
ram.text: After this unit makes a Move action, if it is in base contact with any enemy units, select one of those units and roll one D6. On a 5+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

artillery-battery.name: Artillery Battery
artillery-battery.text: Each Heavy Support slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single Heavy Support slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

effigy.name: Effigy
effigy.text: You can re-roll Morale tests taken for friendly ORKS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.
